content: Keep the desktop UI's established look, which the user approved on 2026-10-08 from the a553 journey screenshots. It has a navy brand header (--brand #1f3a5f), a light canvas (#f2f4f7) with white panels, an 8px radius, and Segoe UI text with Cascadia Mono for code. The results list sits on the left (20–26rem) and the part detail on the right. Symbols render on KiCad's light schematic paper and footprints on KiCad's dark board (#001023). Each error state has one alert, and supporting notes stay quiet. Reuse the tokens in apps/desktop-ui/styles.css rather than adding colours, and extend this layout rather than redesigning it.
